The '''Mynockra system''', also known as the '''Ord Mynock system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prefsbelt sector/Legends|Prefsbelt sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].
